title: String length and copy
description:
Write `strlen` and `strcpy` as functions.

```
strlen("assembly") = 8
copy: assembly
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
word1:  db      "assembly", 0

        section .bss
copy:   resb    32

        section .text
my_strlen:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel word1]
        call    my_strlen
        mov     rdi, rax
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: In `my_strcpy`, keep the destination in `rax` from the start so it is ready to return.
requirements: `my_strcpy(rdi = destination, rsi = source) -> rax = destination`, copying the zero too.
Use only the scratch registers (`rax`, `rcx`, `rdx`, `rsi`, `rdi`, `r8` to `r11`) so nothing needs saving.
stretch: Write `my_strcmp` that returns a negative, zero or positive number like C's.
